messages:
priya_cs: Heads up team — Novara returned the vendor security questionnaire. They want specific evidence for MFA, idle session timeout, and API key rotation cadence. Can someone confirm exact values we can provide?

jules_sec: We can provide: (1) MFA enforcement via SSO for all human console users (Okta enforce + 2FA), (2) session idle timeout = 30m default, (3) key rotation guidance: user creds 90d, service tokens 30d recommended, and export of key metadata (created_at, last_rotated_at).

anita_onboard: Novara also asked if we enforce MFA for CLI/API access when using user tokens. Short answer?

jules_sec: CLI using SSO-backed user sessions inherits MFA. Non-interactive API keys do not have 2FA; best practice is short-lived tokens and automated rotation. We can provide our internal credential rotation policy PDF and an export of recent rotations as evidence.

priya_cs: Can we get the export now? They want a timestamped CSV showing last_rotated_at.

deploy-bot: automation: export started for novara-api-keys (id: exp-2977).

anita_onboard: FYI for redaction: remove raw key values and redact full UUIDs if we share the CSV. Keep owner, created_at, last_rotated_at columns.

jules_sec: Agreed. Also include a screenshot of Console > Security > Session Policies showing 30m idle timeout and the Okta CA policy screenshot. We'll attach SOC2 mapping doc for Access Control section.

deploy-bot: automation: export completed (file: exports/novara/novara_api_keys_2026-03-21.csv).

priya_cs: Nice. I'll assemble a reply: attach CSV, session timeout screenshot, Okta CA screenshot, SOC2 access-control mapping, and the rotation policy excerpt. Anyone want to review before I send?

anita_onboard: Quick skim ok from me. Two optional notes to include: BYOK availability on Dedicated/Private, and guidance about rotating long-lived API keys if they use hosted.

jules_sec: Add a line clarifying KMS model: hosted customers use our managed KMS; BYOK/HSM available for Private & Dedicated (includeSales link).

priya_cs: Draft prepared, pinging Jules for final review in thread. Will send by EOD. :thumbsup:
